Nyansa frɛ
1Nyansa asi ne dan,
wasene n’adum nson;
2 # Mat 22.4 wakum ne mmoa, wafra ne nsa,
na wasiesie ne pono nso;
3wasoma ne mmaawa,
ɔkɔteam kuro mu sorɔnsorɔmmea so sɛ:
4Deɛ ɔyɛ atetekwaa mmane ha!
na deɛ ɔnni tire no, ɔse no sɛ:
5Mommra mmɛdi m’aduane no bi,
na monnom me nsa a mafra no bi.
6 # Mmb 1.22 Monnyaa ntetekwaayɛ na monnya nkwa,
na monnante nhunumu kwan so.
7Deɛ ɔtenetene ɔfɛdifoɔ no soa aniwuo,
na deɛ ɔka ɔbɔnefoɔ anim no nya nkekaeɛ.
8 # Mmb 23.9 Nka ɔfɛdifoɔ anim na wantane wo;
ka onyansafoɔ anim, na ɔbɛdɔ wo.
9Tu onyansafoɔ fo, na ɔbɛkɔ so ahunu nyansa,
ma ɔteneneeni nhunu de, na ɔbɛkɔ so n’adenim mu.
10 # Mmb 1.7 Ampa ara nyansa mfitiaseɛ ne AWURADE suro,
na ɔkronkronni no ho nimdeɛ ne nhunumu.
11 # Mmb 3.2, 16 Na me nti na wo nna bɛdɔɔso,
na wɔde nkwa mfeɛ bɛka wo ho.
12Sɛ wohunu nyansa a, wohunu fa,
na sɛ wodi fɛw a, wo nko na wobɛsoa.
Nkwaseasɛm ho kɔkɔbɔ
13Ɔbaa kwasea yɛ ɔkasafoɔ,
tibɔnkɔso a ɔnnim hwee;
14ɔtena ne fie aboboano,
kuro mu sorɔnsorɔn hɔ adwa so,
15sɛ ɔrefrɛ wɔn a wɔresene ɔkwan soɔ,
wɔnam wɔn nkwammɔeɛ so tee no sɛ:
16Deɛ ɔyɛ atetekwaa mmane ha!
Na deɛ ɔnni tire nso, ɔse no sɛ:
17 # Mmb 20.17 Nsuo a wɔwia yɛ fremfrem,
na ahuntaduane yɛ dɛ!
18Nso onii no nnim sɛ nsamanfoɔ wɔ hɔ,
Asamando abunu mu na wɔn a wahyia wɔn no wɔ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Nyansa asi ne dan,
wasene n’adum nson;
wakum ne mmoa, wafra ne nsa,
na wasiesie ne pono nso;
wasoma ne mmaawa,
ɔkɔteam kuro mu sorɔnsorɔmmea so sɛ:
Deɛ ɔyɛ atetekwaa mmane ha!
na deɛ ɔnni tire no, ɔse no sɛ:
Mommra mmɛdi m’aduane no bi,
na monnom me nsa a mafra no bi.
Monnyaa ntetekwaayɛ na monnya nkwa,
na monnante nhunumu kwan so.
Deɛ ɔtenetene ɔfɛdifoɔ no soa aniwuo,
na deɛ ɔka ɔbɔnefoɔ anim no nya nkekaeɛ.
Nka ɔfɛdifoɔ anim na wantane wo;
ka onyansafoɔ anim, na ɔbɛdɔ wo.
Tu onyansafoɔ fo, na ɔbɛkɔ so ahunu nyansa,
ma ɔteneneeni nhunu de, na ɔbɛkɔ so n’adenim mu.
Ampa ara nyansa mfitiaseɛ ne AWURADE suro,
na ɔkronkronni no ho nimdeɛ ne nhunumu.
Na me nti na wo nna bɛdɔɔso,
na wɔde nkwa mfeɛ bɛka wo ho.
Sɛ wohunu nyansa a, wohunu fa,
na sɛ wodi fɛw a, wo nko na wobɛsoa.

Ɔbaa kwasea yɛ ɔkasafoɔ,
tibɔnkɔso a ɔnnim hwee;
ɔtena ne fie aboboano,
kuro mu sorɔnsorɔn hɔ adwa so,
sɛ ɔrefrɛ wɔn a wɔresene ɔkwan soɔ,
wɔnam wɔn nkwammɔeɛ so tee no sɛ:
Deɛ ɔyɛ atetekwaa mmane ha!
Na deɛ ɔnni tire nso, ɔse no sɛ:
Nsuo a wɔwia yɛ fremfrem,
na ahuntaduane yɛ dɛ!
Nso onii no nnim sɛ nsamanfoɔ wɔ hɔ,
Asamando abunu mu na wɔn a wahyia wɔn no wɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
